study.question: Does excluding action/recency from field relevance KEYS, while retaining them in aligned VALUES and the pooled norm, improve current-ad-conditioned retrieval beyond a generic change of history-only pooling? Observed starting point: baseline-static/pooled/din AUCs are 0.6050036145/0.6102261137/0.6133619861. g2-r0001-target_separate achieves 0.6153351064 versus target_consensus 0.6146090565 and context_separate 0.6110239483. Its supplied diagnostic on only the first 512 validation impressions reports mean history length 118.1152, field-attention L1 1.48553, target-versus-context L1 1.03279, and norm error below 1e-6; this establishes execution characteristics, not causal explanation. Source audit of candidate.py (SHA256 c20e1e85a306d704ca462b5e37851fff287848b4d958c22355da1c3b030fc8fa) shows nonlinear scores use field+action+recency keys. The observation is this unresolved coupling, not demonstrated harmful contamination. Multiple trajectories delimit the next test: r0000 target directional beats scalar (0.6114152 vs 0.6100255) but misses DIN; r0002 union/crossed reads (0.6149205/0.6138332) miss aligned replay (0.6153351); r0003 inverse-action-count balancing (0.6144011) and shifted prior (0.6134877) miss global replay; r0004 late target fusion (0.6143828) barely exceeds its wide sum control (0.6142684), and both miss the narrower incumbent. Its target-minus-context fusion interaction is only 0.00008808. Replays reproduce a single seed; they are not independent repetitions.
study.hypothesis: Independent semantic field matching may work better when action/recency embeddings do not alter its nonlinear relevance keys. Metadata remains available in retrieved values, so the proposed mechanism changes where relevance is computed, not event coverage or classifier capacity. If this is specifically useful for current-ad matching, semantic-only keys should improve the target-query contrast more than the history-only-query contrast. This is provisional: temporal and action-dependent relevance could instead require the inherited mixed keys.

nearest_work.difference: DIN already conditions historical-behavior pooling on an ad and models explicit relations. It relaxes softmax normalization to retain interest intensity. We inherit local relation scoring but retain the frozen softmax and pooled-norm control; the proposed delta is exclusion of common metadata from category/brand keys. Not exact DIN reproduction and no priority claim for semantic-only keys.

Exact parent source available and inspected. Change only scorer key inputs from category+common and brand+common to category and brand. Preserve values, scoring network, initialization order, classifier, norm matching and optimizer/loss.
Only the author README was available; it confirms category, brand and behavior type without item IDs. No DMR full-paper mechanism was verified, reproduced or claimed as new here.

QueryFormer generates and refines query probes through attention and incorporates recency in sequence embeddings. No generated probes, field-sequence bridge, multiple views or source losses are adopted. This experiment isolates key composition in an existing shallow scorer; it does not test the source architecture.

UniDot retains explicit cross-boundary interactions with dual buses, conditional sequence gates and per-layer highway readouts. We retain inherited query-key products inside the scorer only; no highway, buses, deep sequence encoder, auxiliary supervision or optimizer change. Global novelty remains unverified.

study.proposed_difference: The four standalone modules implement a 2x2 factorial: semantic_target (candidate), mixed_target (parent replay), semantic_context (control), mixed_context (context replay). The only forward-path architecture switch is semantic_keys: scorer inputs use category/brand embeddings alone when true, and field+common when false. The common vector is still action+recency, and the value remains sum_i[wc_i*category_i + wb_i*brand_i + 0.5*(wc_i+wb_i)*common_i]. All four allocate exactly the same parameters in the same construction order. Diagnostics separately compute both key choices within each trained checkpoint; those counterfactual diagnostics are descriptive, not substitute held-fixed training contrasts. New diagnostics report semantic/mixed attention distance and summary cosine, key-metadata ablation sensitivity, attention normalization/padding, empty-history summary, value decomposition, selected/uniform action masses and ages, and norm matching. The first-512 diagnostic scope cannot support population slice or significance claims. All observations in this proposal are prospective-record provenance for host ingestion; no human-owned knowledge or separate memory files are edited.
predictions: Primary: AUC(semantic_target) > AUC(mixed_target) on the same full validation population. Screening gain >=0.0002 is a predeclared practical trigger for paired-seed follow-up, not a significance threshold.
Target-specific account: I=[AUC(semantic_target)-AUC(mixed_target)]-[AUC(semantic_context)-AUC(mixed_context)] > 0. A target gain with I <= 0 supports at most a generic key-composition effect.

Successful reproduction: mixed_target should recover 0.6153351063827704 AUC and 0.19662737633898195 Logloss, and mixed_context should recover 0.6110239483241536 AUC at seed 42 under the same host. Require absolute differences <=1e-6 for a numerical replay audit; larger discrepancies trigger provenance/execution investigation, not automatic duplicate calls.

Implementation diagnostics: metadata_zeroed_attention_l1_nonempty is zero for semantic keys by construction; padding mass and empty-history summary are zero; attention mass sums to one on nonempty histories; norm/decomposition errors stay within floating-point tolerance (relative norm tolerance 1e-5). These verify the intervention only.

Predeclared exploratory slice contrasts: inherited history-length bins, action-presence slices and category-match present/absent slices, with host-provided sample/positive/negative counts. No predicted slice winner; do not select favorable slices post hoc. Empty-history differences across separately trained models are shared-parameter effects, not event-reading evidence.

Parameter counts match the parent (17130275 with current metadata); forward compute and inference latency should be similar. Actual host wall time, allocated GPU seconds if supplied, train seconds, throughput, p50/p95 and peak memory govern cost claims. Missing cost measures remain missing.
falsifiers: semantic_target ties or underperforms mixed_target: no screening support for this implementation; particularly a loss >=0.0002 argues against advancing it on the present budget priority.
A gain also present equally or more with context queries (I <= 0) rejects the claimed target-specific interpretation even if semantic-only keys are a useful generic replacement.
A gain disappears or reverses over paired seeds 42,43,44: retain preliminary/unstable outcome, not repeated mechanism support.
Norm, attention-mass, padding or replay checks fail: an implementation/provenance problem invalidates attribution before a scientific conclusion.

Small changes within seed variation do not establish that metadata is harmful. Failure of this full exclusion does not refute additive metadata salience, field-specific time conditioning, or all semantic/metadata separation.
alternative_explanations: Equal allocated parameters do not give identical effective function classes or gradients.
Removing common from keys changes key scale as well as metadata dependence; an improvement alone cannot separate denoising from conditioning/scale effects.
Matching history norm is within each trained model, not equality of learned norms across models; pooled norms and embeddings may adapt.
Action/time remain in selected values and pooled reference norm, so this is not an information-removal test of the whole predictor.
Existing exploratory selection on this validation day and one screening seed limit generalization and uncertainty claims.
Beneficial mixed-key routing may encode legitimate action-specific relevance and recency preference; semantic-only keys intentionally remove that route.

An apparent gain could be implicit regularization from a restricted scorer, rather than improved semantic matching. A later norm-matched mixed-key or additive metadata-bias replacement would discriminate these accounts.
Bucket equality in supplied diagnostics is not necessarily original entity equality; category/brand missing values are excluded from new match-mass diagnostics.
Static snapshots have undocumented as-of dates; causal prefixes are host-enforced, but production point-in-time validity is not established.

contrasts.decision_if_supported: Positive target gain plus positive interaction is provisional controlled support for target-specific key separation. Freeze all four comparison cells plus closest references for repeats before making stronger claims.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Read archived primary arxiv:2609.16548v1 section 4.2 lines 128-192. It establishes query refinement as prior context, not local need. Previous declared consideration accompanied union/action/late-fusion branches that did not beat the aligned incumbent; no source-specific transferred benefit was measured.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: None adopted from the source. Existing fixed queries are retained; only semantic-versus-metadata composition of relevance keys changes.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: No query-generation pipeline, bridge, Co-Transformer or view scaling. Generic ad-conditioned retrieval is inherited from DIN and local parent.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: This factorial cannot validate or refute QueryFormer. Nonpositive local target-specific interaction rejects only the present separation account.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: The retrieved organizer card has no detailed original report/implementation or full ablation protocol. Prior declared non-adoption remains consistent with executed source changes; token-allocation attribution is unresolved.

knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: Tests field-key metadata inclusion at constant allocated capacity, not a token-budget mechanism.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: No outcome here validates/refutes the source allocation claim. A detailed primary method and a capacity-matched local tokenization experiment would be required.
